beliefs: Only the first character of the string is shifted backward by one in the alphabet (a->z, b->a, ..., z->y; A->Z, B->A, ..., Z->Y) [E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7]
All characters after the first are left unchanged, including letters, digits, spaces, and symbols [E4, E5, E6, E7]
If the first character is not a letter (digit, space, symbol), it is left unchanged [E1]
notes: The shift applies only to the first character, not all letters; every later character passes through unchanged. This explains all observed outputs including boundary cases like 'a'->'y' and 'z'->'x'.
